Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Even if there are sloppy conditions, the washer keeps the camera's view clean. Rear camera with washer is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe

This 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe Premier delivers the capability and comfort you need for any journey, backed by a clean history and single-owner reliability.

- 22" Polished Aluminum Wheels
- Bose 10-Speaker Centerpoint Surround Audio System
- SiriusXM with 360L
- Hands-Free Rear Power Programmable Liftgate
- Remote Start
- Wireless Charging
- Heated & Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated 2nd Row Outboard Seats
- 3rd Row 60/40 Power-Folding Split-Bench Seat
- Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert
- Rear Cross Traffic Alert
- Safety Alert Seat
- Magnetic Ride Control Suspension
- Auto High-Beam Headlights
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with the 10-speed automatic transmission provides the power and efficiency you expect from a full-size SUV. With rear-wheel drive and an adaptive suspension system, this Tahoe handles the road with confidence while maintaining a composed ride for your passengers. The 3.23 rear axle ratio balances performance and efficiency for both highway cruising and daily driving situations.

Inside, the Preferred Equipment Group 1LZ equips you with premium features designed for modern convenience. The heated steering wheel, power-adjustable steering column, and memory seat settings adjust to your preferences automatically. Dual-zone automatic temperature control keeps everyone comfortable, while the rear air conditioning ensures those in back stay cool on warmer days. The power rear liftgate opens hands-free, making loading cargo effortless whether you're at the store or on an adventure.

Your connection to the road remains secure with multiple safety technologies built throughout the vehicle. Lane change alerts warn you of vehicles in your blind zones, while rear cross traffic alert helps when backing up. The safety alert seat provides tactile feedback to complement visual warnings. Four-wheel independent suspension with Magnetic Ride Control adapts to road conditions in real time, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS give you reliable stopping power.

Entertainment and information stay within reach through the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System, which integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for seamless smartphone connectivity. The 10-speaker Bose audio system delivers quality sound whether you're listening to SiriusXM satellite radio or your personal music library. Remote start lets you warm up or cool down the cabin before you even step outside.

The three-row seating accommodates your entire family with front bucket seats offering 12-way power adjustment, heated front seats with ventilation for personalized comfort, and heated second-row outboard seats for additional passengers. The power-folding third row creates flexible cargo space when needed, and the perforated leather seat trim adds a refined appearance throughout.

As a one-owner vehicle with a clean CarFax report, this Tahoe Premier represents a well-maintained example ready for its next chapter. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this capable SUV firsthand and discuss how it fits your transportation needs.

This 2024 Ford Expedition Timberline delivers the capability and comfort you need for family adventures and daily driving. With one owner and a clean CarFax, this silver SUV represents a well-maintained vehicle ready for its next chapter.

- 3.5L V6 EcoBoost High Output engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission
- 2-Speed Automatic 4WD with neutral towing capability
- Equipment Group 501A High Package with premium leather seating
- 2nd Row Leather Trimmed Power-Folding Captain's Chairs with tip-and-slide access
- Radio: B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 12 speakers and subwoofer

The Expedition Timberline balances practicality with refinement through its comprehensive feature set. The 3.5L EcoBoost engine provides the power you need while the 4WD system ensures capable handling in various conditions. The dual-zone automatic climate control keeps all passengers comfortable, while the rear air conditioning ensures the third row stays cool on long drives.

Entertainment and connectivity define the cabin experience. The B&O Sound System delivers quality audio through twelve speakers, and the capacitive touchscreen puts navigation, climate, and vehicle controls within reach. Connected Navigation gives you real-time traffic updates and predictive route suggestions, keeping you informed throughout your journey.

For the active family, this Expedition Timberline offers intelligent features that make hauling easier. The Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package includes an Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Pro Trailer Backup Assist, simplifying trailer maneuvering. The 360-Degree Camera with Split View provides clear visibility for parking and backing scenarios, while Reverse Brake Assist offers an extra layer of safety.

The interior accommodates your lifestyle with thoughtful design. Leather-trimmed power-folding Captain's Chairs in the second row combine comfort with accessibility, while the Panoramic Vista Roof floods the cabin with natural light. Heated and ventilated front seats adapt to seasonal conditions, and the heated steering wheel adds warmth during winter months.

This one-owner, clean CarFax Expedition Timberline awaits your inspection. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the quality, capability, and comfort this vehicle offers your family.

description: Experience refined driving with the 2027 INFINITI QX60 LUXE, featuring advanced safety, luxurious comfort, and innovative technology in a sleek Harbor Gray SUV. The 2027 INFINITI QX60 LUXE combines a turbocharged 4-cylinder engine with a smooth 9-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive for responsive, efficient performance. Its aluminum wheels and performance tires front and rear enhance handling, while the brake-actuated limited-slip differential adds stability. Safety is paramount with features like blind spot monitoring, cross-traffic alert, lane departure warning, lane keeping assist, front and rear collision mitigation, and a comprehensive airbag system including knee and side airbags. Automatic headlights with high beams and integrated turn signal mirrors provide added visibility. Inside, the QX60 LUXE offers premium synthetic bucket seats with heating and cooling functions, adjustable lumbar support for driver and passenger, and power-adjustable seats with memory settings. The third-row seating and pass-through rear seat ensure versatile passenger and cargo configurations. Enjoy the panoramic sun/moonroof that fills the cabin with natural light. Technology includes an aerial view display system, adaptive cruise control with steering assist, a premium sound system, Bluetooth connectivity, and a back-up camera. Additional conveniences like a heated steering wheel, power liftgate, remote engine start, and keyless entry enhance everyday usability. This INFINITI QX60 LUXE is designed for those who appreciate luxury, safety, and advanced features in a sophisticated SUV. Be sure to call or visit Cerritos Nissan to discover more. Your new favorite vehicle awaits - don't let someone else drive it home!

Coupled with a smooth 9-Speed Automatic transmission and paddle-mounted sequential shift controls, this crossover provides immediate power delivery when merging or accelerating. Driver visibility is elevated by the Smart Rear View Mirror Digital feed and the 3D Around View Monitor with Moving Object Detection. Looking for used vehicles for sale in Oklahoma City? At Bob Moore INFINITI we have a large assortment of used vehicles including a variety of makes and models. While we carry many used makes and models, we also carry used INFINITIs in case you aren’t looking for new models. If you’re still trying to decide which model and trim is the best fit, we can get you with one of our certified INFINITI specialists to go over all the details — whether it’s regarding features, warranties, service, financing, or any other areas you’d like addressed. All our inventory is held on our website where you can complete the whole purchase process. If you need to schedule any of these services, please call our dealership.

This process includes a 106-point inspection of the vehicle to ensure that it’s up to our standards. We make sure the tires have three 30-second tire depths or 30%, if they don’t, we’ll replace the tires. We’ll also replace any brakes over 3mm. This includes a complimentary car wash and vacuum with every service. Prior to your service, contact our dealership team to get your service appointment set up. Financing a vehicle purchase can be a stressful process but Bob Moore INFINITI offers a seamless auto financing, with over 20 lenders to work with. This helps us ensure that we’re getting you the best deal possible for your new car. If you have any questions when going through the financing, don’t stress. We’ll have our INFINITI finance expert there with you to answer any questions or concerns you might have. Do you need to trade in your current vehicle? We buy cars too. Whether it’s a trade-in for a new purchase or just simply selling your vehicle, we’d love to work with you.

Vehicle Details
INFINITI COURTESY VEHICLE
The 2027 INFINITI QX65 SPORT is a low-mileage INFINITI of Boerne courtesy vehicle with fewer than 10,000 miles and has never been titled or registered to a retail owner. Its 268-horsepower 2.0-liter VC-Turbo engine, nine-speed automatic transmission and Intelligent All-Wheel Drive are complemented by SPORT-specific gloss-black exterior details, 20-inch gloss-black alloy wheels, a 16-speaker Klipsch premium audio system and climate-controlled front seats, creating a more athletic interpretation of INFINITI's five-passenger luxury crossover. This dealer courtesy vehicle offers that nearly new experience at a significant discount from the original MSRP.
It is sold as INFINITI Certified with a 6-year/75,000-mile limited warranty from the original in-service date, plus INFINITI Certified benefits. INFINITI of Boerne also provides the complimentary Synergy Commitment, additional powertrain protection through a total of 7 years/100,000 total odometer miles from the original in-service date. The distinction matters: the 6-year/75,000-mile protection is INFINITI Certified limited warranty coverage, while the Synergy Commitment is complimentary powertrain protection provided by INFINITI of Boerne.
The QX65 takes a different approach to luxury utility than a conventional three-row SUV. Its five-passenger layout allows the design to emphasize two-row comfort and cargo flexibility, while the SPORT trim adds visual character through gloss-black exterior accents, an illuminated front grille emblem with INFINITI Light Path and gloss-black wheels. The result is a crossover with a lower, more athletic personality while retaining the everyday practicality expected from an INFINITI. As a courtesy vehicle, it has served in dealership transportation duty and has been maintained and regularly inspected by INFINITI of Boerne's factory-trained technicians. Its pricing reflects that prior dealership service, creating the opportunity for meaningful savings compared with the original MSRP without a previous retail owner.
Performance comes from INFINITI's 2.0-liter VC-Turbo four-cylinder, producing 268 horsepower and 286 lb-ft of torque. Variable-compression technology is engineered to alter the engine's compression characteristics as driving demands change, balancing stronger response under acceleration with efficiency during lighter-load operation. A nine-speed automatic transmission provides a broad spread of ratios, while Intelligent All-Wheel Drive can help distribute power according to available traction. Selectable drive modes further tailor vehicle behavior for different conditions. That combination suits the QX65 particularly well to everything from an I-10 commute to the changing elevations and curves of a Hill Country weekend drive.
Inside, the SPORT is designed around the driver without compromising passenger comfort. TailorFit-appointed seating gives the cabin a contemporary luxury character, while climate-controlled front seats address both sides of Texas weather by providing heating and ventilation. Tri-zone automatic climate control allows separate temperature preferences within the cabin, and the panoramic sunroof brings additional light into both seating rows. The five-passenger configuration is especially appealing to buyers who want genuine passenger room and cargo versatility but have no need for a seldom-used third row.
Technology is integrated to reduce friction rather than simply add more screens. A 12.3-inch multi-function driver display places key vehicle information directly ahead of the driver, while Google built-in with navigation provides familiar connected functionality within the vehicle. Wireless smartphone integration helps keep the cabin uncluttered, and the SPORT's 16-speaker Klipsch premium audio system provides a richer, more immersive listening environment. Multi-color ambient lighting adds another layer of personalization, allowing the cabin atmosphere to change without altering its clean overall design.
The SPORT trim also adds useful camera technology, including Front Wide View, Invisible Hood View and an Intelligent Around View Monitor. These systems use exterior camera perspectives to provide information that can be difficult to see from the driver's seat, particularly when maneuvering in confined parking areas or judging obstacles near the front of the vehicle. ProPILOT Assist adds another layer of driver support, combining technologies designed to help manage speed, following distance and steering assistance during compatible driving conditions. On longer highway trips, that assistance can reduce some of the repetitive workload while keeping the driver responsible for operating the vehicle.
The appeal of this QX65 is ultimately about the combination of condition, status and value. It has fewer than 10,000 miles, has never had a retail owner and has received its maintenance and inspections within the dealership environment. For an executive, frequent traveler or luxury buyer who wants current technology and contemporary design without paying full new-vehicle pricing, a nearly new INFINITI courtesy vehicle occupies an attractive middle ground.
Because it has never been titled or registered to a retail owner, this QX65 SPORT may qualify for special leasing programs for qualified customers. INFINITI of Boerne can explain the available purchase and leasing options based on the customer's individual needs.
INFINITI of Boerne is a 2026 J.D. Power Dealer of Excellence, the first INFINITI retailer in Texas to earn it, and a Five-time INFINITI Award of Excellence recipient with a 4.8 Google rating from more than 1,000 reviews. Located directly on Interstate 10 north of San Antonio, the dealership serves luxury buyers throughout Greater San Antonio and the Hill Country, while complimentary Texas home delivery makes purchasing from farther away straightforward.
Experience the 2027 INFINITI QX65 SPORT at INFINITI of Boerne and discover what makes a low-mileage courtesy vehicle such a compelling way to own a nearly new INFINITI.

The emphasis is on delivering an upscale on-road experience in everyday driving. Wide door openings make it easy to get into the QX60. How's the tech? The 12.3-inch Google-powered center display screen responds quickly to touch. The QX60 features plenty of charging ports for front and second-row passengers.
